mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_user_id owner,requirement_id,custom_order_id order_id,purpose,payload_hash digest,storage_key,file_name name,attachment_type type,created_at FROM custom_material WHERE owner_user_id=#{owner} AND upload_key=#{key}
SELECT id,owner_user_id owner,requirement_id,custom_order_id order_id,purpose,payload_hash digest,storage_key,file_name name,attachment_type type,created_at FROM custom_material WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id,owner_user_id owner,requirement_id,custom_order_id order_id,purpose,payload_hash digest,storage_key,file_name name,attachment_type type,created_at FROM custom_material WHERE custom_order_id IN #{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custom_requirement_attachment WHERE material_id=#{id} AND requirement_id=#{root})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custom_delivery_record WHERE custom_order_id=#{root} AND JSON_CONTAINS(evidence_json,JSON_QUOTE(#{key}))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custom_order_extension_request WHERE custom_order_id=#{root} AND request_status!='draft' AND JSON_CONTAINS(evidence_json,JSON_QUOTE(#{key}))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custom_after_sale_request WHERE custom_order_id=#{root} AND JSON_CONTAINS(evidence_json,JSON_QUOTE(#{key})))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM custom_after_sale_factory_statement s JOIN custom_after_sale_request a ON a.id=s.after_sale_id WHERE a.custom_order_id=#{root} AND JSON_CONTAINS(s.evidence_json,JSON_QUOTE(#{key})))
